basis: Childhood periodic fever is an autoinflammatory syndrome; fever alone does not establish damage to other organs.
Scalp hair shaft dysplasia; abnormalities are confined to hair.
Infection and inflammation of the kidney; the uterine parent conflicts with the explicit definition.
Benign squamous epithelial neoplasm arising in the larynx; HPV association alone does not add an infection axis.
Ovarian germ cell tumour has a reproductive origin; hCG secretion does not establish endocrine disease, and metastatic organ frequencies are unspecified.
Muscle tissue neoplasm classified under musculoskeletal disease; cardiac involvement is restricted to a minority of subtypes.
Villous epithelial neoplasm arising in the urethra, which belongs to the renal axis.
Immunodeficiency defines ICF3; intellectual disability occurs in 2/5 patients (40%). Recurrent otitis does not establish lasting ear damage.
Anorectal malformation and deafness define the syndrome. HPO reports nephropathy in 80-99%, despite conflicting renal wording in the definition.
Craniosynostosis, synostosis and brain malformations define it; renal defects 80-99%, PDA 30-79%. Eyelid, ear and airway anomalies omitted by cap.
Defined by cortical, basal ganglia and corpus callosum malformations; other organ disease is not established across the umbrella.
Carcinoma originates in the urinary bladder; neuroendocrine histology does not itself establish endocrine dysfunction.
Parathyroid hyperplasia causes primary hyperparathyroidism; skeletal bone loss is common, roughly half. Subtype-specific skeletal frequency is uncertain.
Neurodevelopmental disability, hypotonia and seizures define Dup15q. Minor clinodactyly does not establish functional skeletal damage.
The supplied name describes lethal short-limb skeletal dysplasia; no definition or phenotype data support additional axes.
Clonal plasma cell proliferation; the umbrella includes MGUS, so myeloma-associated bone and renal damage cannot be generalized.
Pathological mucus accumulation and distension within the appendix.
Lymphoid cell malignancy arising in the colon or rectum; lymphoma also requires the infectious_immune mechanism axis.
Developmental disability and skeletal anomalies define Kabuki syndrome; hearing loss ~50%, heart defects ~40-50%. Renal, dental and immune findings omitted by cap.
Borrelia bacterial infection umbrella; no additional damaged organ is consistently established across its subtypes.
Inherited iron metabolism disorder causing hypochromic microcytic anemia; other organ damage is not common.
Malignant germ cell tumour originates in the ovary, a reproductive organ; occasional hCG secretion does not establish endocrine disease.
Partial 8q duplication syndromes commonly cause developmental delay and intellectual disability; structural organ findings vary with the duplicated segment.
Encapsulated thymic epithelial tumour; thymus is outside the listed anatomical axes. Associated autoimmune disorders are separate diseases.
Androgenetic loss of scalp hair; androgen sensitivity does not itself establish an endocrine disorder.
